title_fa: کایرو، مردی که زمان را شکست داد
title_en: KAIRO – The Man Who Defeated Time

voice.tone: medium-low, warm, slightly mysterious, natural Iranian conversational accent

continuity_anchors.kairo: stickman, slightly oversized round head, small black dot eyes, simple expressive eyebrows, movable mouth line, four short hair strands, thin simple arms and legs, slightly oversized feet. Proportions never change.
continuity_anchors.kairo_present: black business suit, white shirt, black tie, dark shoes
continuity_anchors.kairo_prehistoric: simple primitive brown animal-hide tunic, bare feet, wooden spear while hunting. No modern accessories.
continuity_anchors.predator: large prehistoric big-cat-like predator: low heavy shoulders, massive head, short rounded ears, long thick tail, tawny-grey matted fur with a dark dorsal stripe
continuity_anchors.map: circular amber stone tablet, concentric rings, twelve radial grooves, star-point markers, unknown angular glyphs, one blank destination node
continuity_anchors.cave: narrow south-facing entrance in a rock outcrop above dry grass, 40 m descending passage with a right-hand bend, then a large domed chamber with a waist-high stone platform at its centre
continuity_anchors.room: dark modern room, single worn leather armchair, warm yellow floor lamp on camera-left, heavy curtain camera-right, round wall clock above the chair
